tools.name: score_applicant_with_formula
tools.description: Computes a numeric score for an applicant from their recorded attributes using a scoring formula supplied by the recruiter, such as '0.5*years_experience + 2*skills_match'. Returns the score and the attributes used.

params.name: applicant_id
params.description: ID of the applicant in the local applicant store

params.name: formula
params.description: Arithmetic scoring formula referencing applicant attribute names

tools.name: filter_candidates_by_expression
tools.description: Filters a CSV file of job candidates using a Python-style boolean condition over column values, such as 'years_exp >= 5 and location == "Berlin"'. Returns the names of matching candidates.

params.name: csv_path
params.description: Path to the candidates CSV file

params.name: condition
params.description: Boolean expression using CSV column names

tools.name: apply_resume_field_transform
tools.description: Applies a short Python transformation snippet to a field in an applicant's stored profile and saves the updated value. Use it to normalize fields such as phone numbers or job titles.

params.name: applicant_id
params.description: ID of the applicant whose profile is updated

params.name: transform_code
params.description: Python statements that read 'value' and assign the new result to 'value'
